_note: This skill's checked-in routing corpus. NOTE: typography-lettering is a REFERENCE skill — it ANSWERS, compares, and explains type questions and points at peers (ui-compose-typography for tokens/scale math, ui-verify-i18n for locale) for output; it does NOT generate tokens or grade on two axes. Its frontmatter uses ## Invocation + domain sections, not the decomposer template, but the corpus still applies: does the description route on real typography questions and hold against siblings? Positives span the invocation families (classification, anatomy/metrics, scripts/diacritics, modern CSS text surface + OpenType/variable axes, legibility/accessibility, pairing) plus 2-3 indirect/symptom paraphrases. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from real in-repo siblings — component-decomposer (web-component API/geometry, explicitly NOT type), layout-decomposer (UI structure), color-science (the sister reference skill — color, not type) — plus GENERATE/grade requests that a builder or decomposer owns (a reference skill answers; it does not emit a type scale, build a token sheet, or grade two axes). IMPORTANT: routing-eval measures LEXICAL TOKEN OVERLAP only — it is a legibility aid, not a verdict. The indirect/symptom positives deliberately share few surface words and may score recall 0.000; that is a proxy limit (paraphrase-blindness), not a description defect. Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
